description: I’m interested in space, gaming, technology, and creating exciting new experiences. I’m working on a space-themed game where players can explore the universe, discover new worlds, and take on challenging missions.
summary: My Game is an interactive space mission simulator that transforms complex aerospace trade-offs into a hands-on engineering challenge. Built for students and aspiring mission designers, the game puts players in the lead systems engineer’s seat to plan, build, and operate a space mission from initial concept to orbital execution. Players must balance competing real-world constraints—including mass budgets, power generation, payload selection, launch vehicle capacity, and orbital mechanics—where every design decision directly impacts mission cost and survival. By replacing abstract textbook concepts with real-time cause-and-effect simulation, [Project Name] empowers learners to experiment with high-stakes spaceflight engineering, learn from failure, and optimize mission success.
details:
What It Does & How It Works
My Game is an interactive 2D space mission design and simulation game built in Unreal Engine 5. Players step into the role of a lead systems engineer tasked with planning, building, and launching a complete space mission from initial concept to orbital operations.

  • Mission Planning & Spacecraft Assembly: Players start with a set budget and scientific objective, then customize their spacecraft by choosing launch vehicles, scientific payloads, power systems, and communication modules.
  • Real-Time Trade-Off Simulation: Every component added dynamically alters the spacecraft's total mass, power consumption, data transmission rate, and cost.
  • Launch & Orbital Execution: Once designed, players launch their spacecraft into a simulated 3D space environment where orbital constraints, fuel efficiency, and system limits determine whether the mission succeeds or fails.
